thread_text:
Claire J: Need a short, sharp launch kit for Vanguard (enterprise offering) \u2014 single-page CISO summary + 1-page engineer checklist + 90s SDR script + webinar run-of-show. Low hype, factual, routing rules.
Marco D: I can take the CISO 1-pager. Focus: security controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs), SLA tiers, deploy modes (hosted/dedicated/private), and a single ROI example.
Liz H: I'll draft the field checklist: network egress, certs, sample helm/compose snippet for private, healthcheck curl. Keep it copy-pasteable.
Ibrahim A: Benchmark anchors for the 90s script: P50 ~40ms, P99 ~85-95ms hosted; Dedicated private demo shows ~65-75ms P99 at 140 req/s. Batching+cache reduces token spend ~25%. Mark as "example values".
Claire J: Great. For inbound routing: map to three buckets -> trial/self-serve, SDR (security questions), AE (private or SLA >= 99.9). Include a tiny pseudo-rule in the one-pager.
Marco D: Draft pseudo-rule: ```
if requested_deploy == 'private' or requested_sla >= 99.9:
  route = AE_enterprise
elif mentions_compliance or wants_audit:
  route = SDR_security
else:
  route = self_serve_trial
```
Liz H: CTAs: "Request pilot", "Start free trial", "Schedule security review" with UTM pattern utm_source=marketing, utm_campaign=vanguard_launch, utm_content={cta}.
Ibrahim A: 90s SDR script suggestion: "In ninety seconds: Vanguard gives product teams SLA-backed inference and private deployment options, predictable latency (P99 ~85-95ms hosted; better on dedicated), and batching that cuts token spend ~25%. Interested in a pilot?"
deploy-bot: Webinar created: "Vanguard: Secure SLA-backed Inference" on 2026-08-20 14:00 UTC -> https://events.redwood/vanguard (auto-reg).
Claire J: Webinar run: 12m exec overview, 20m demo (deploy modes + routing), 15m benchmark/customer story, 13m security ops Q&A.
Marco D: I'll put CISO bullets and the mini routing flow in the doc by EOD Tue. Liz will add engineer checklist by Wed. Ibrahim will post the benchmark CSV and slide by Wed PM.
Liz H: Sample healthcheck I'll include: ```
# healthcheck
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' https://private.vanguard.internal/v1/health
```
Claire J: Perfect. Final design freeze Fri AM. Keep copy conservative and cite "example workload" where numbers used. :white_check_mark:
